content: Ubhwiyagaaruri bhu Umukiriisitʉ
Kiriisitʉ atʉhɨɨrɨ ubhwiyagaaruri korereke twikarɨ mubhwiyagaaruri. Nangʉ mwimɨɨrɨrɨ bhwɨma, mutiisirirya kʉgarʉka naatu mʉbhʉmbʉʉsa bhwi imigirʉ.
Mwitegeerere kɨnʉ inyɨ Paaurʉ nɨkʉbhabhʉʉrɨra! Arɨɨbhɨ muriisirirya kʉsaarwa igʉrʉ wu ukugwata imigirʉ ja Musa, Kiriisitʉ atakʉbha na bhwera bhwʉbhwʉsi kwa niimwɨ.
Nɨrabhabhʉʉrɨra naatu, umusubhɨ wʉwʉʉsi wʉnʉ akwisirirya kʉsaarwa, areenderwa kugwata imigirʉ jʉsi ja Musa.
Arɨɨbhɨ muriisega kʉbharwa kʉbha abhaatʉ bhe eheene mʉbhʉtangɨ bhwa Mungu ku ukugwata imigirʉ, momenye kʉbha mwiyahwirɨ kwa Kiriisitʉ, na mutigirɨ ɨbhɨgʉngi bhya Mungu.
Nawe Ekoro Ɨndɨndu ɨratʉnaja itwɨ kwisega tʉrabharirwa eheene kʉnzɨra yu ubhwisirirya.
Mmbe arɨɨbhɨ tugwatɨɨnɨ na Yɨɨsu Kiriisitʉ, kʉsaarwa hamwɨ kʉtama kʉsaarwa kʉtaana bhwera bhwʉbhwʉsi. Ekegero chu ubhwera nu‑bhwisirirya bhʉnʉ bhokokora emeremo kʉbhʉsɨɨgi.
Imwɨ mwarɨ mʉraja bhwaheene! Nangʉ nɨ‑wɨɨwɨ abharɨchiryɨ mʉtagwata amaheene?
Ʉbhʉkʉrʉkʉmbi bhuyo bhʉtaruurɨ kwa Mungu wʉnʉ abhabhirikiirɨ.
Nawe momenye, “Ubhutunduuru bhusuuhubhu bhʉratunduurya riigiri ryʉsi!”
Nɨna amaheene kʉbha imwɨ mʉragwatana nʉ Ʉmʉkʉrʉ Yɨɨsu, kwɨbhu mʉtakwisirirya kʉkangiribhwa. Nawe ʉmʉʉtʉ wʉwʉʉsi wʉnʉ araabhanyaachɨ, aratinirwa.

Abhahiiri bhaanɨ, arɨɨbhɨ nɨkɨɨrɨ nɨrarwaza kʉbha ereenderwa kʉsaarwa, kwakɨ nangʉ Abhayaahudi bharaanyaacha? Angabhɨɨrɨ nɨmbu, ubhurwazi bhwanɨ igʉrʉ wʉ ʉmʉsarabha gwa Kiriisitʉ bhʉtaarɨ bhʉragirya bhanyiigatanɨrɨ.
Niriigomba bhanʉ bhakʉbhanyaacha kʉmangʼana gɨ ɨsaarʉ, bhangiitinirɨ abheene!
Ukwikara kʉbhʉnaja bhwe Ekoro Ɨndɨndu
Abhahiiri bhaanɨ, mubhirikiirwɨ korereke mʉbhɨ bhu ubhwiyagaaruri. Nawe ubhwiyagaaruri bhwanyu bhʉtagirya mutunɨ isimʉka yʉ ʉbhʉbhɨ, nawe mwisakiryɨ kʉbhʉsɨɨgi.
Imigirʉ jʉsi ja Musa giri mwiswaja rɨmwɨ rɨnʉ, “Ʉmʉsɨɨgɨ nyarʉbhɨri waazʉ chɨmbu wisɨɨgirɨ.”
Nawe arɨɨbhɨ muriirya amatimba, mwangarɨrɨ mʉtaaza kwiricha imubheene ko bheene.
Mmbe, nɨrabhabhʉʉrɨra, mʉbhɨ mʉrakangatwa ne Ekoro Ɨndɨndu. Moreekorebhu, mʉtakutuna naatu isimʉka yʉ ʉbhʉbhɨ.

Nɨrabhabhʉʉrɨra, ku riyo bhyʉsi bhɨnʉ ʉmʉbhɨrɨ gukwigomba, bhɨtarɨ chɨmbu Ekoro Ɨndɨndu ikwenda, na chɨmbu Ekoro Ɨndɨndu ikwenda, bhɨtarɨ chɨmbu ʉmʉbhɨrɨ gukwigomba. Ekoro Ɨndɨndu nʉ ʉmʉbhɨrɨ bhɨrahakaana, ku riyo mʉtakwenderwa kokora chʉchʉsi kɨnʉ mukwenda mokore.
Arɨɨbhɨ mʉrakangatwa ne Ekoro Ɨndɨndu, mʉtarɨ iyaasɨ wi imigirʉ.
Mmbe, amangʼana ganʉ gakokorwa igʉrʉ wi isimʉka yʉ ʉbhʉbhɨ nɨ‑ganʉ: ikisimbɨ, ɨtaarʉ, kokora amangʼana ga zɨsʉni,
kosengera amasambwa, ʉbhʉrʉgi, ubhubhisa, iryʉmana, rihari, ʉbhʉrʉrʉ, ɨkɨnyawɨɨtʉ, ʉbhʉtaamanʼya, ɨkɨmbʉrʉʉri,

engʼeera, ubhunywi, ʉmʉsʉʉhʉ na amangʼana agandɨ gʉʉsi ganʉ gatuubhɨɨnɨ na gayo. Nɨrabhabhʉʉrɨra chɨmbu namarirɨ kʉbhabhʉʉrɨra kʉbha, abhaatʉ bhanʉ bhakokora amangʼana gayo, bhatakʉgabha chʉchʉsi mʉbhʉtɨmi bhwa Mungu.
Nawe arɨɨbhɨ tʉrakangatwa ne Ekoro Ɨndɨndu, tʉrabha nu umusumʉ gwe Ekoro Ɨndɨndu. Umusumʉ guyo nɨ‑bhʉsɨɨgi, obhozomerwa, omorembe, ubhwigumirirya, ʉbhʉzʉmu, bhwerya koro, obhoronge,
ʉbhʉnyʉʉhu ne ekerengo. Gʉtareeho umugirʉ gʉnʉ gukwanga amangʼana ncha gayo.
Abhaatʉ bhanʉ bhagwatɨɨnɨ na Yɨɨsu Kiriisitʉ, bhatakuhirwa kɨbhɨ ni isimʉka yʉ ʉbhʉbhɨ, hamwɨmwɨ na amiisɨɨgi gaabhʉ amabhɨ, kʉ kʉbha bhagabhambirɨ kʉmʉsarabha gwa Yɨɨsu.
Turiikarɨ kubhwisɨgi bhwe Ekoro Ɨndɨndu, tutunɨ ʉbhʉkangati bhwazɨ.
Tutiikumya bhʉʉha, tutiimohyaku mangʼana na kwirorera rihari.

footnotes.text: Enzobhooro yaku nɨ‑kʉbha amiija gʉ ʉrʉrɨmɨ ga abhaatʉ bhasuuhu, garakangirirya abhaatʉ bhaaru.
Ʉbhʉtɨmi bhwa Mungu. Kʉmaragɨrɨra bhʉkʉngʼu, rora Ikiniibhasa.
